_key.description: Source term key, the relationship predicate and the target term key, joined by underscores.

_from.description: Handle of the source OncoTree term.

_to.description: Handle of the parent OncoTree term, or of the NCIT cross-reference.

inverse_name.description: The same relationship in the opposite direction.

type.description: Same value as name: subclass of the parent tumor type, or database cross-reference to NCIT.

source.description: Dataset this edge was loaded from.

class.description: The class of the ontology term to ontology term edge

method.description: The method of the ontology term to ontology term edge, from the associated files_filesets record

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the OncoTree tumor-type dump this edge was read from.
